note: What a server sends to change the unit a spell already in a unit's slot is cast from. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: slot
bits.note: Which slot. A champion's own spells count from 0.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot counts among the summoner slots, so that 0 and 1 name those two.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit the spell is cast from. A client takes an id it does not know as no unit.
